title: E-Commerce Administrator
description:
E-Commerce Administrator

Location: Besthorpe, Norfolk

Pay: 13.00 - 14.00 per hour (Depending on Experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm

Join a Growing Online Business

Our client, a well-established and expanding business specialising in fuel additives, engine lubricants and automotive performance products, is seeking an experienced E-Commerce Administrator to support and maintain the online side of their operation on a temporary to permanent basis.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a friendly team and play a key role in the continued growth of a successful online business.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the day-to-day running of the company's e-commerce platforms
- Managing and maintaining product listings across Amazon, eBay and other online marketplaces
- Uploading new products and updating existing listings
- Monitoring online orders and customer enquiries
- Ensuring product descriptions, pricing and stock levels are accurate and up to date
- Assisting with the development and maintenance of online sales channels
- Working closely with colleagues to support business growth and customer satisfaction

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in an e-commerce, online sales or administration role
- Essential experience using Amazon Seller Central and eBay business platforms
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicator with a professional approach
- Self-motivated and able to manage workload effectively
- A positive team player with a proactive attitude
- Good IT skills and confidence using online systems and software

Additional Information

Due to the rural location of the site in Besthorpe, own transport is highly desirable.

What We Offer
- Competitive pay rate of 13.00 - 14.00 per hour, depending on experience
- Monday to Friday working pattern with no weekends
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful business
- Temp-to-perm opportunity!

title: E-Commerce Coordinator
description:
E-commerce Coordinator (Moto-Electrical)

Maternity cover ASAP until September 2027 could lead to a permanent role too as they are super busy!

You will need your own transport to get to the location as not near pubic transport.

Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm

Salary will depend on previous expereince £32 K - £35 K

Varied work and a friendly work environment!

You will be Supporting the day-to-day management and development of the company's e-commerce channels, ensuring products, content, promotions and customer information are accurate, up to date and presented effectively. The role works closely with marketing, sales, operations, customer service and warehouse team as well as the external partners to help maximise online sales and customer experience.

Key responsibilities

Website & Online Store Management by working closely with Web Admin
- Ensure product information, availability and promotions are accurate.
- Check website pages regularly for errors, broken links and outdated content.
- Support website merchandising and product categorisation.
- Assist with website updates and new product launches.

E-commerce Operations
- Monitor orders and liaise with internal teams regarding stock.
- Coordinate product launches, promotions and seasonal campaigns.
- Maintain product and customer-related information across relevant systems.

Sales & Performance
- Monitor online sales, orders, conversion rates and website traffic.
- Produce regular e-commerce reports and performance updates.
- Identify issues or opportunities affecting online sales.
- Support promotional activity and online trading plans.
- Assist with analysing sales and customer data.

Marketing & Content
- Ensure website content is consistent with the company's brand.
- Support SEO activities by maintaining accurate product descriptions, page titles and other website content.
- Assist with social media and digital marketing activity where relevant.

Marketplace Management
- Maintain product listings on marketplaces such as Amazon, eBay or other third-party platforms.

Administration & Coordination
- Maintain e-commerce spreadsheets, product databases and reports.
- Coordinate with suppliers,
- Raise and track website or system issues.
- Assist with stock and product data management.

Skills & experience
- Previous experience in e-commerce, retail, digital marketing or a similar environment.
- Good understanding of online retail and customer journeys.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Confident using Excel or Google Sheets.
- Experience with an e-commerce platform such as eBay, WooCommerce or similar is desirable.
- Basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
- Comfortable working with data and identifying errors or trends.

Please email your CV to Louise asap and I look forward to hearing form you!

title: Marketing & Social Media Executive
description:
We are looking for a commercially minded Marketing & Social Media Executive to join our small & ambitious Marketing Team. You ll take ownership of engaging content and organic social media while supporting SEO, paid social, digital PR and website development. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines creativity with data-led thinking and understands how great content drives traffic, enquiries and sales.

What you ll do
- Plan, create and manage content across website, Instagram, Facebook and other digital channels.
- Own the content calendar, organic social activity and community engagement
- Write website, product, campaign, blog and customer-story content
- Support SEO, digital PR, link building and paid social campaigns
- Work with colleagues, agencies, photographers and videographers to produce strong creative assets
- Track performance using GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush and social reporting tools, turning insight into clear actions.
- Help set meaningful KPI S for content, social media, SEO and digital campaigns, aligned with wider business objectives
- Analyse engagement, rankings, enquiries, conversion rates and cost per lead to understand which activity delivers the strongest commercial return.
- Produce clear monthly reports that explain performance, identify opportunities and recommend actions to improve the quality and volume of sales enquiries.

What were looking for in a Marketing & Social Media Exec:

We are looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial awareness. You should enjoy developing engaging content but also want to understand how that content performs and how it contributes to traffic, enquiries and ultimately sales.

You will be naturally curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working with data and prepared to challenge or change marketing activity when the results suggest a different approach is needed.
- At least two years experience in a marketing, content or social media role.
- Excellent copywriting, proofreading and editing skills.
- Experience creating commercial website and campaign content and managing business social accounts.
- Data driven with a good working knowledge of SEO and digital performance reporting
- An organised, proactive approach, strong attention to detail and a creative eye.
- Experience with paid social, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Acrobat or Canva is advantageous.

Rewards & benefits being offered:
- £30,000 £35,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working: three days in the office and two from home
- 28 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Health Shield healthcare cash plan
- Death in service insurance
- Contributory pension scheme
- Excellent staff facilities with full equipped kitchen area
- Opportunity to use the company holiday home
- On site parking

Interested? Apply today with your CV and tell us how your content and social media experience could help grow the Crane Garden Buildings brand.

title: Ppc
description:
We have an exciting role with our client based in Norwich who are looking to recruit a Biddable Manager to manage their large paid social media and PPC campaigns. This role is offering flexibility for home working.

The role responsibility will be to drive the maximum number of quality leads into the business.

Main Responsibilities
- Management of Paid Social channels for 3 national market leading brands with laser focus on ROI.
- Working with eight figure budgets on diverse range of biddable accounts, platforms (e.g. Meta, Google & Microsoft) and campaign types (e.g. Paid Social, Search, Pmax, Demand Gen).
- Developing & implementing audience (including first party data) and creative strategies which drive performance and growth for paid social channels.
- Optimising and briefing the wider team to create bespoke landing pages for paid social to maximise the volume of high-quality leads.
- Manage bids utilising an array of fully automated bidding solutions to offline conversion actions.
- Digital agency and supplier liaison from tech providers and key media owners including Google, Meta, Microsoft Ads.
- Collaborate with an award-winning London based Search agency to implement cutting edge PPC technology.
- Collaborate with tech platform Account and Industry managers to optimise campaigns and drive performance delivery.
- Martech usage including Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, Search Ads 360, Display Video 360). Other martech including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Bot Management tool.
- Report into Biddable Media Lead to ensure all activity falls in line with the wider paid media strategy.

Performance measures
- Primary Paid Media metrics such as cost per acquisition and return on investment/advertising spend.
- Secondary Paid Media metrics including of cost per click, click through rate, conversion rate.
- Spend to planned budget & cost of sale % by region by product.

Knowledge and Experience
- Digital marketing background (either client or agency side).
- Minimum of 2-4 years' experience of hands-on management of large paid social campaigns and budgets.
- Excellent analytical skills.
- Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written formats.
- Proficient user of Microsoft packages.
- Knowledge of Google Marketing Platform particularly CM & SA360.
- Experience in Lead Generation preferrable
- Knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads interfaces and Editors (although full training will be given).
- Specific Digital Marketing qualifications.
- Meta Blueprint certified

Please apply with your updated CV.

title: Senior CRM Manager
company: Select Recruitment Specialists Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you ready to take CRM from a campaign-sending function to a genuine strategic growth channel?

Do you get a buzz from turning customer data into retention, lifetime value and revenue?

If so, read on.

My client is a fast-growing digital business with an ambitious marketing team and a real appetite for growth. A new Head of Marketing has joined, CRM is now a key strategic priority, and they're looking for an experienced CRM leader to own it.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing and leading a CRM team of 2, you'll own the CRM strategy, customer lifecycle and retention roadmap. This is a role where you'll set the direction and also get stuck in to deliver it.

You'll be responsible for:
- CRM strategy: defining and delivering the CRM vision, strategy and roadmap to improve retention, lifetime value and profitability
- Lifecycle management: designing and optimising customer journeys across onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, loyalty and high-value segments
- Segmentation: building advanced segmentation frameworks using behavioural, transactional and customer value data, moving well beyond simple recency targeting
- Personalisation and automation: creating a personalisation roadmap across email, SMS, app push and on-site, and growing the revenue contribution of automated journeys
- Testing: building and leading a structured testing programme and a genuine culture of experimentation
- Insight and performance: working with the Data team on cohort analysis and reporting, and owning CRM metrics including retention, CLV, reactivation and channel revenue
- Platform and governance: optimising the CRM platform and unlocking AI and predictive capabilities, while maintaining robust QA, processes and GDPR compliance
- Team leadership: coaching and developing your team into a high-performing unit
- Collaboration: partnering with Performance Marketing, Product, Content, Data and Commercial teams to connect acquisition and retention

Must-haves
- Strong consistent experience leading a team in CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing
- A background in a fast-moving digital, subscription, ecommerce, gaming or betting business
- Hands-on experience with CRM and automation platforms such as Klaviyo, Braze, Iterable or Salesforce Marketing Cloud
- A proven track record of measurable improvements in retention, revenue, customer value or engagement
- A strong understanding of segmentation, cohort analysis and lifecycle frameworks
- Experience developing personalisation and automation across email, SMS, app push and digital journeys
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex data into commercial action
- Confident stakeholder management and the ability to influence senior leaders

About you

You're commercially minded, organised and comfortable in a high-growth environment where processes and tools are still evolving. You can balance strategy with hands-on delivery, and you bring technical, commercial and creative people together around the customer.

What's on offer
- Amazing salary on offer
- A senior, strategic role with real ownership and influence
- The chance to shape and lead a growing CRM function
- A high-growth business with ambitious plans
- A Norfolk-based role with flexibility to travel

Interested?

Send your CV to Emma Baylis at Select Recruitment Specialists, or get in touch for a confidential chat NOW.
